cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You brought soup? I'll prepare your dinners for a week. Label portions by date, please; guessing isn't meal planning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're ill. I've already filled your freezer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then when I'm up, I'll fill yours for a month. Properly portioned; we won't waste your space on half-empty tubs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's tiny. Just return the tubs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Measure the alcove for me, width and depth. I'll return them full inside a freezer that fits. Both measurements, please; I don't order appliances by hope.

reason: Make A professional portioning and appliance-fit corrections organise ever-larger gifts, with B tiny-freezer fact directly causing the expanded repayment.
